title: Unbounded strcpy from caller parameter into fixed-size struct field
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/profile_label.c:L29 calls strcpy(slot->label, label) inside aurora_profile_label(); 'label' is an unchecked char* parameter and slot->label is a fixed-size field of struct profile_slot defined at L17-20; a string longer than the field overwrites adjacent struct memory.
